senses.gloss: (v.שָׁתַה II) to lay the foundation of, start.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 11:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XI, 3</cite> <he>אם הצדיקים שהִשְׁתִּיתוּ עולמך וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00090"><he>פָּגַר</he></cite>

senses.gloss: to be founded. Ib. אם אבן שתיה שממנה ה׳ העולם וכ׳ if the wicked come and destroy the foundation stone (v. שְׁתִיָּה II) from which the world was started &c.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20">Lev. R. s. 20</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 54b">Yoma 54ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="U02100"><he>שְׁתִיָּה</he> II</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26b:8">Snh. 26ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>תוש̇יה</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 28:29">Is. XXVIII, 29</cite>, as a name of the Torah) <he>דברים של ת̇והו שהעולם מְשׁוֹּתָּת עליהן</he> mere words, and yet the world is built upon them; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 653">Yalk. Ps. 653</cite> <cite ref="U02141"><he>שׁוּתָּת</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="U02140">same</cite>. Tanḥ. K’doshim 10; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 3:6">Tosef. Yoma III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:6">II</cite>), 6 (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="U02093"><he>נִשְׁתָּה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="U02093"><he>שָׁתָה</he> II</cite>).
